answers: Right answers hurt the boss. Wrong ones make it angrier, and that question comes back later.
bear: This bear holds a fun fact from the paper. Jump on its head to collect it, but don't touch its sides!
blocks: Bump question blocks from below. They hold coins, hearts, and shields.
boss: Every world ends with a boss. Jump on its head, and it asks you a question about the paper.
continue: CONTINUE picks up right where you left off.
controls: Press A and D to run, and W or Space to jump. S drops you down through thin platforms.
controls-touch: Hold the arrow buttons to run, and press the jump button to jump.
feedback: Played a while? Tell us what you think with FEEDBACK.
flag: Reach the flag to clear the level. Then you can read every fact you collected.
goodbye: You can replay this tour from ABOUT. Good luck, scholar!
hearts: These hearts are your lives. Bears, spikes, and pits each cost one.
leaderboard: Finish a whole paper, and your score goes on its LEADERBOARD.
lesson: Next, I teach you one idea from the paper, a page at a time.
levelselect: Every level and boss earns up to three stars. Replay any of them from LEVEL SELECT.
missed: It can also retest just the questions you missed, until you get them right.
newgame: NEW GAME lets you pick a paper, search millions more, or upload your own PDF.
notebook: The NOTEBOOK keeps every lesson, fact, and question you unlock, so you can study them later.
pause: Press P, or the pause button up here, to pause the game any time.
practice: After each lesson comes a practice question. Get it right to earn an extra heart.
review: Read the paper already? REVIEW skips the levels and tests you, one boss at a time.
scholar: Still curious? Choose ASK THE SCHOLAR and type any question about the lesson.
settings: SETTINGS changes the music, text speed, and difficulty. HARD mode is there for a challenge.
welcome: Welcome, young scholar! I'm the professor. Let me show you around before your first paper.
